ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an acyl fragment, with R connected to the left side of the carbonyl carbon, and H+ that can be protonated marked above the carbonyl oxygen; the α-carbon on the right side of the carbonyl is connected to a positively charged pyridinium nitrogen ring, and the six-membered aromatic ring where [n+] is located is visible; AcO−, Br−, and H+ are also separately marked in the figure, and there are several curved arrows. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, ignore the arrows and record only atoms, bonds, labels, and formal charges. R is represented by the SMILES wildcard *, and starting from the carbonyl connected to R it is written as *C(=O)C; this α-carbon is further connected to the positively charged pyridinium ring, written as [n+]1ccccc1, so the main fragment is *C(=O)C[n+]1ccccc1. AcO− is transcribed as acetate CC(=O)[O-], Br− is transcribed as [Br-], and H+ is transcribed as [H+]. These are unconnected components, connected with dots.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Inspect the image and inventory only the atoms, bonds, labels, and formal charges, not the arrows. Convert the main fragment by starting at the generic R/wildcard attached to the carbonyl carbon, writing `*C(=O)C`, then attach that alpha carbon to the positively charged pyridinium ring as `[n+]1ccccc1`. Separately translate the visible acetate anion label `AcO−` to `CC(=O)[O-]`, the bromide ion to `[Br-]`, and the proton to `[H+]`. Join the disconnected components with dots to obtain `*C(=O)C[n+]1ccccc1.CC(=O)[O-].[Br-].[H+]`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个酰基片段，羰基碳左侧连有 R，羰基氧上方标有可被质子化的 H+；羰基右侧的 α-碳连到一个带正电的吡啶鎓氮环，[n+] 所在六元芳环可见；图中还单独标有 AcO−、Br− 和 H+，并有若干弯箭头。推理：按题意忽略箭头，只记录原子、键、标签和形式电荷。R 用 SMILES 通配符 * 表示，从 R 连接的羰基开始写为 *C(=O)C；该 α-碳再连接带正电的吡啶鎓环，写作 [n+]1ccccc1，因此主片段为 *C(=O)C[n+]1ccccc1。AcO− 转写为乙酸根 CC(=O)[O-]，Br− 转写为 [Br-]，H+ 转写为 [H+]。这些是不相连的组分，用点号连接。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn transition-state image as a static chemical structure: an R-substituted carbonyl attached to an alpha carbon bonded to a pyridinium nitrogen, plus separate labeled ions/groups H+, Br−, and AcO−; note the positive charge on the pyridine nitrogen and the negative charges on bromide and acetate, while disregarding all curved arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent the generic R attachment as wildcard `*`, write the acyl fragment as `*C(=O)C`, encode pyridinium as `[n+]1ccccc1`, encode acetate as `CC(=O)[O-]`, bromide as `[Br-]`, proton as `[H+]`, and separate disconnected species with periods.
